meta.siteTitle: Helibol — Helicopter services in Bolivia since 1988
meta.siteDescription: Family-run helicopter operator based in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. Energy & mining, rescue & MEDEVAC, aerial firefighting, cargo, VIP and scenic flights. Bell 212, Bell 412 and H125.
meta.servicesDescription: Energy & mining, rescue & MEDEVAC, aerial firefighting, cargo & construction, VIP & scenic flights, film & photography.
meta.fleetDescription: Bell 212, Bell 412 and Airbus H125: the right aircraft for every mission.
meta.aboutDescription: A family company flying since 1988 from Hangar 22, El Trompillo, Santa Cruz.
meta.operationsDescription: 100+ exploration projects across Bolivia, Argentina and Peru.
meta.scenicDescription: Give the gift of the sky: scenic helicopter flights in Santa Cruz and across Bolivia for birthdays, anniversaries, proposals and more.
meta.quoteDescription: Tell us your mission and a specialist will contact you within one business day.
meta.contactDescription: Hangar 22, El Trompillo Airport, Santa Cruz de la Sierra. 24/7 emergencies: +591 3 352 9469.

hero.eyebrow: VERTICAL EFFICIENCY · EST. 1988 · SANTA CRUZ, BOLIVIA
hero.title: Where the roads end, we begin.
hero.sub: Since 1988, we've flown people, cargo and help to Bolivia's most remote corners, with 38 years of experience and the care of a family company.

services.title: A helicopter for every mission.
services.lead: We study the terrain, the altitude, the payload and the goal, and recommend the exact aircraft for the job. Nothing more, nothing less.

story.title: We're a family company. We fly like one.
story.body: Helibol was born in 1988 in a hangar at El Trompillo with a single Bell 47 and one conviction: distance should never leave anyone without help. Thirty-eight years later, our pilots, engineers and crew still follow the same rule: everyone who comes aboard comes home. Yours and ours.

fleet.title: The right fleet, ready to fly.
fleet.turnkeyBody: Need your own aircraft? We'll help you source, inspect and import it through our international network.

map.title: We've already been there.
map.lead: 100+ exploration projects across Bolivia, Argentina and Peru. Here are some of the most recent.

safety.title: Safety isn't a department. It's our culture.

pillars.title: Internationally audited
pillars.body: We meet IOGP standards and are audited and approved by top-tier international operators.

pillars.title: Experienced crews
pillars.body: Pilots and engineers with deep experience over jungle, altiplano and mountains.

pillars.title: Rapid response
pillars.body: Engineers, parts and advice one call away, with direct lines into our international network.

pillars.title: Expert advice
pillars.body: We recommend the aircraft with exactly the capacity your mission needs.

safety.eco: Long-line operations reduce the need to clear helipads, protecting the places we work in.

aboutPage.title: A family of aviators, since 1988.
aboutPage.lead: Helibol was born in a hangar at El Trompillo with a Bell 47. Today it's one of Bolivia's largest helicopter operators — and still a family company.

timeline.title: The first flight
timeline.body: With a Bell 47 at Hangar 22, El Trompillo, Helibol is born with one conviction: distance should never leave anyone without help.

timeline.title: The energy sector
timeline.body: Oil and mining exploration takes us into the jungle, the foothills and the altiplano. We add twin-engine aircraft and international standards.

timeline.title: Argentina and Peru
timeline.body: Our experience crosses borders: we support exploration projects in Argentina and Peru.

timeline.title: Bell 412 and H125
timeline.body: We add the four-blade Bell 412 and the Airbus H125, king of high altitude.

timeline.title: 38 years in the air
timeline.body: 100+ exploration projects, rescues, fires and thousands of passengers who made it home.

people.body: Captains at home in the jungle, the Chaco and the altiplano. High, hot and remote is a normal day at the office.
Licensed engineers who keep every aircraft airworthy, inspection after inspection, mission after mission.
Crews trained to secure, load and care for patients from the field to the hospital door.
The team behind the 24/7 line: planning, fuel, permits and flight following for every sortie.
